stateCoordinate: Output-equivalent deliverable MWh; conversion loss booked at charging, not a physical heat-timing claim.
scope: A stipulated one-day bucket calculation, not a real solar/wind generation trace, weather simulation or full resource-adequacy study.
No costs, tariffs, purchases, trades, generator ranking, lifecycle comparison or cost-of-service recommendation.
The ideal100% storage case is a mathematical upper illustration; real storage conversion is lossy.
Demand flexibility, other generators, grid imports, transmission, outages, degradation and reserves are outside this isolated model.
timeConvention: 24 invented constant-power one-hour buckets. Hour0 starts the illustration, not a real midnight, sunrise, location or measured solar day. Every worked case starts empty; final stored energy is explicit.
